name: Adelaide University Whyalla Student Support Grant
summary: $3,000 grant for 100% online Adelaide University students in the Whyalla region affected by the blast furnace closure.
key: The value of the Grant is $3,000
who: Enrolled part-time or full-time in a 100% online undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
Live in the Whyalla region, or rely on a Whyalla household member affected by the blast furnace closure and redundancies
Australian citizen, permanent resident, New Zealand citizen or permanent humanitarian visa holder
catches: Applications open Monday 28 September 2026 and close Sunday 25 October 2026
Must be used in the year it is offered
